name: What the education ministry says: MBHTE's published figures
note: MBHTE publishes no dataset, and its website turns away automated visits, so these are the figures the ministry and the Bangsamoro Parliament have given in official releases and in statements reported by the press, each as stated and with where it was said. They count more than DepEd's school files do (government madaris, community learning centres, alternative learning, higher education) and do not always agree with one another; they are kept as said, not reconciled.
